description: Match keywords against the published public portfolio of ITEON projects, with an optional industry filter. Returns project descriptions, technologies, periods, outcomes, and case study links. Uses word matching, not semantic search.

industry.description: Optional industry filter: banking, insurance, government, fintech, energy, retail, agriculture, consumer.

query.description: Topic, technology, or keywords (e.g. "Java legacy migration", "React Native mobile", ".NET Core API integration", "ECM banking").

name: case_studies.find_relevant
